Hi Priya,

Really enjoyed speaking yesterday — thanks again for the thoughtful questions during the architecture deep-dive. We're excited to extend an offer to join Redwood Inference as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the ML Platform team.

Summary (formal offer attached):
- Base salary: $210,000
- Equity: 0.35% RSU vesting over 4 years
- Signing bonus: $15,000 (one-time)
- Target start date: Jan 12, 2027
- Relocation/remote: remote role (US-based) with a discretionary home-office stipend

Attachments: offer_letter_v1.pdf (PDF)

Next steps: If you'd like to accept, sign via DocuSign and we'll begin onboarding and security checks. If you have questions or anything you'd like to discuss (comp, start date, visa support), reply and cc me.

Thanks — hope we can make this work. We think you'd be a great fit for the platform team.

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@gmail.com>

Subject: Re: Offer: Senior ML Engineer at Redwood Inference

Hi Olga,

Thank you for the offer and for the fast turnaround. I'm very excited about the role and the team — the infra + KV cache work really resonates. I want to be transparent: I have another in-flight offer from a competitor (AI-stack startup) that came in at $225k base and a slightly higher equity target, and they asked for a decision by 2026-11-19.

I'm strongly leaning toward Redwood given the product and folks, but the differential is meaningful given Bay Area cost-of-living and the counteroffer timeline. Two things I wanted to ask:
1) Is there flexibility on base salary (an increase to $222,000 would close the gap)?
2) If base isn't adjustable, could we consider a modest increase to the sign-on bonus or small equity uplift?

If possible I need to have a firm response to the competing team by EOD 2026-11-19. Happy to jump on a quick call today or tomorrow. Appreciate any help you can provide — I really want to make the right decision and would prefer Redwood if we can find a path.

Thanks,
Priya
(priya.desai@gmail.com)

Subject: Fwd: Offer negotiation — need approval for comp flex / geo premium

Marcus / Sean,

Forwarding Priya's reply — she has a competing offer with a decision deadline of 2026-11-19 and is requesting either a base increase to $222k or a larger one-time sign-on / equity uptick. Candidate is strongly leaning toward Redwood but price sensitive.

What we have to work with: current req budget sits at $210k base (midpoint of band). HR @talent-ops flagged comp_band_chart.xlsx attached — the role's band tops out at $215k without an exception. We can do a manager discretionary sign-on (up to $20k) but any increase to base to $222k would require approval from People Ops and Finance for a band exception.

Requesting: quick yes/no on either (A) approve manager sign-on up to $22k and push equity by +0.05% (still within budget) OR (B) approve temporary geo-premium band exception to allow base $222k and equity +0.02%.

Candidate's timeline is tight — would like to respond before EOD 2026-11-19. Could you reply with preference and, if you approve band exception, confirm who will route the People Ops ticket? I opened HR-487 (link below).

Attachments: comp_band_chart.xlsx
Related link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-487

Thanks — if easier, we can take a 15-min call this afternoon.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Recruiting Lead, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-15T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Offer negotiation — need approval for comp flex / geo premium

Olga / Sean —

Thanks for the context. I value Priya's experience and the match to platform needs; I do not want to lose her on a $10-12k delta. Given constraints, I'm comfortable with option (A): increase the one-time sign-on to $22k and bump equity by 0.05%. I prefer to keep base within band and avoid a formal band exception. This keeps comp philosophy consistent while addressing the candidate's near-term differential.

Action items:
- Olga: update offer with revised signing bonus ($22k) and equity 0.40% — attach revised offer and route DocuSign.
- Sean / People Ops: please confirm payroll/legal routing for sign-on payment (timing, taxes) and confirm we can process by start date. If any issue, loop me in.

I'll approve this spend. Keep the candidate timeline in mind and aim to get final to Priya by 2026-11-15 EOD.

Marcus Lin
Hiring Manager, ML Platform
